To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Office Relocation Notice

We are pleased to announce that our company will be relocating to a new office building at 450 Market Street, effective March 1st. The new office offers significantly more space, a modern conference center, and is conveniently located near public transportation.

Employees are asked to pack their personal belongings by February 25th. Moving boxes will be distributed to each department by February 15th. IT equipment, including computers and monitors, will be handled separately by the IT department and should not be packed by individual employees.

Parking permits for the new location will be issued during the first week of March. Employees who currently have a parking permit do not need to reapply; permits will be automatically transferred.

If you have any questions about the move, please contact the Facilities Management office at extension 204.

New Conference Room Booking System

Starting next Monday, all conference room reservations must be made through our new online booking system, RoomFlow. This system replaces the previous paper-based sign-up sheets that were used in each department.

To book a room, log in to RoomFlow using your company email address and select an available time slot. Rooms can be booked up to 30 days in advance, but no more than 4 hours per booking. If you need a room for a longer period, please contact the office administrator directly.

Cancellations must be made at least 2 hours before the scheduled time. Failure to cancel or show up for three consecutive bookings may result in temporary suspension of booking privileges.

Training sessions on how to use RoomFlow will be held on Tuesday and Wednesday at 10 AM in the main conference room. Attendance is optional but recommended for all employees.

Restaurant Review: Riverside Bistro

Riverside Bistro, located along the waterfront downtown, has quickly become one of the city's most popular dining destinations since opening six months ago. The restaurant specializes in modern European cuisine with a focus on locally sourced ingredients.

The menu changes seasonally, offering dishes that highlight fresh, regional produce. Standout dishes include the grilled salmon with herb butter and the roasted vegetable risotto. Portion sizes are generous, and prices are reasonable for the quality offered.

The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed, making it suitable for both business lunches and casual dinners with friends. However, the restaurant does not accept reservations for parties of fewer than four, which can result in long wait times during peak hours, especially on weekends.

Overall, Riverside Bistro earns high marks for food quality and ambiance, though the lack of reservations for small groups is a notable drawback.

Notice: Changes to Employee Health Insurance Plan

Effective January 1st of next year, our company will be switching health insurance providers from MediCare Plus to WellPath Health. This change comes after a thorough review process aimed at providing better coverage options and reducing costs for employees.

Key changes include a lower monthly premium for individual coverage, expanded dental and vision benefits, and a broader network of participating doctors and hospitals in the area. However, employees currently seeing specialists outside the new network may need to switch providers or pay out-of-network rates.

Open enrollment will run from November 1st to November 30th. During this period, employees can review plan details and select their preferred coverage options through the HR portal. Employees who do not take action during open enrollment will be automatically enrolled in the plan most similar to their current coverage.

Informational sessions will be held in the main auditorium on November 5th and November 12th at noon. HR representatives will be available to answer questions.
